verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official mobile SDK for the Embedded components onramp, and Stripe's llms.txt points to official Stripe npm packages, so official SDKs exist for at least part of the crypto surface. Coverage of the other crypto products (stablecoin payments, payouts, Treasury) through those SDKs is only implied. Missing for 10: documented server-side SDKs (language list, versions) for stablecoin payments, payouts and financial accounts; SDK reference docs specific to the crypto APIs; independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
